```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'USD'
),
authorized_uncaptured as (
    select a.amount_minor, a.currency, a.business_date
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'authorized'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
)
select null as key,
       cast(round(coalesce(sum(a.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting), 0)) as bigint) as value
from authorized_uncaptured a
join fx on fx.currency = a.currency and fx.rate_date = a.business_date
order by value
```
